label: Altimeter
author: Conky-Studio
description: Aviation-style altimeter face: outer scale, long needle (100s) and short needle (1000s). Bind Value as altitude units of your choice.
lua_draw_body:
local cx, cy, R = {cx}, {cy}, {radius}
 local val = tonumber({value}) or 0
 local fr, fg, fb = {face_color}
 local tkr, tkg, tkb = {tick_color}
 local nr, ng, nb = {needle_color}
 local ar, ag, ab = {accent_color}
 -- face
 cairo_set_source_rgba(cr, fr, fg, fb, {opacity})
 cairo_arc(cr, cx, cy, R, 0, 2 * math.pi)
 cairo_fill(cr)
 -- 10 major ticks (0..9 x 1000 ft style around dial)
 cairo_set_line_cap(cr, CAIRO_LINE_CAP_BUTT)
 for i = 0, 9 do
  local a = -math.pi/2 + i * (2 * math.pi / 10)
  cairo_set_line_width(cr, 2.5)
  cairo_set_source_rgba(cr, tkr, tkg, tkb, {opacity})
  cairo_move_to(cr, cx + math.cos(a)*(R-4), cy + math.sin(a)*(R-4))
  cairo_line_to(cr, cx + math.cos(a)*(R-16), cy + math.sin(a)*(R-16))
  cairo_stroke(cr)
  -- minor
  cairo_set_line_width(cr, 1.2)
  for j = 1, 4 do
   local am = a + j * (2 * math.pi / 50)
   cairo_move_to(cr, cx + math.cos(am)*(R-4), cy + math.sin(am)*(R-4))
   cairo_line_to(cr, cx + math.cos(am)*(R-10), cy + math.sin(am)*(R-10))
   cairo_stroke(cr)
  end
 end
 -- needles: long = hundreds (0-1000 maps full circle), short = thousands
 local hundreds = (val % 1000) / 1000
 local thousands = (val / 10000) % 1
 local a_h = -math.pi/2 + hundreds * 2 * math.pi
 local a_t = -math.pi/2 + thousands * 2 * math.pi
 cairo_set_line_cap(cr, CAIRO_LINE_CAP_ROUND)
 -- thousand (short, fat)
 cairo_set_line_width(cr, 3.5)
 cairo_set_source_rgba(cr, nr, ng, nb, {opacity})
 cairo_move_to(cr, cx, cy)
 cairo_line_to(cr, cx + math.cos(a_t)*R*0.45, cy + math.sin(a_t)*R*0.45)
 cairo_stroke(cr)
 -- hundred (long)
 cairo_set_line_width(cr, 2)
 cairo_move_to(cr, cx, cy)
 cairo_line_to(cr, cx + math.cos(a_h)*R*0.78, cy + math.sin(a_h)*R*0.78)
 cairo_stroke(cr)
 -- hub
 cairo_set_source_rgba(cr, ar, ag, ab, {opacity})
 cairo_arc(cr, cx, cy, 5, 0, 2 * math.pi)
 cairo_fill(cr)
 if {show_value} and studio_draw_text then
  studio_draw_text(cr, string.format('%.0f', val), cx, cy + R * 0.55, {family='Sans', size=12, r=tkr, g=tkg, b=tkb, a={opacity}, align='center', halo=true})
 end
